Home.aCodeContextEngineThatGivesCursor: A code context engine that gives Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex semantic understanding of your codebase
Home.itIndexesRepositoriesIntoStructuredSeman: . It indexes repositories into structured semantic data so coding agents can understand code as naturally as language.
Home.codingAgentsUsuallyUnderstandRepositorie: Coding agents usually understand repositories through repeated grep searches, consuming the
Home.lceTurnsThisIntoOneCallThe: . LCE turns this into one call: the agent describes its task and LCE returns a complete set of relevant code, combining semantic vectors, full-text search, and a symbol graph through
Home.withStructuredEvidenceSuchAsCallChains: with structured evidence such as call chains, definitions, and references. The agent does not need to guess keywords or search repeatedly.
Home.lceProvidesAReadyToUseCloud: LCE provides a ready-to-use cloud service. Copy the MCP configuration into your IDE to use cloud indexing and retrieval.
Home.combinesSemanticKeywordAndExactTermRetri: Combines semantic, keyword, and exact-term retrieval. Describe a task and LCE finds relevant implementations without requiring function or variable names.
Home.connectsWorkflowsAcrossFilesModulesAndPr: Connects workflows across files, modules, and projects using calls, imports, types, and symbol relationships so agents see complete implementations.
Home.resultsIncludeFilePathsSymbolsAndExact: Results include file paths, symbols, and exact line ranges so agents can jump directly to important implementations.
Home.processesOnlyAddedAndChangedFilesRemoves: Processes only added and changed files, removes deleted content, and updates semantic, full-text, and symbol indexes together.
Home.supportsTypescriptJavascriptPythonGoRust: Supports TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++, C#, PHP, Swift, Kotlin, and common configuration and documentation files.
Home.buildsACodeGraphFromAstAnd: Builds a code graph from AST and compiler analysis to track calls, type references, definitions, and imports.
Home.identifiesCallersDependentModulesAffecte: Identifies callers, dependent modules, affected tests, and regression risks before changes are committed.
Home.combinesNaturalLanguageRetrievalExactTer: Combines natural-language retrieval, exact terms, and call relationships to narrow down failure paths and affected implementations.
Home.enhancesNaturalLanguageCodingRequestsWit: Combines a natural-language coding task with retrieved repository context and turns it into explicit goals, requirements, constraints, and verification steps. File and line references are verified by the server.
Home.mcpToolsIntro: When connected through the npm client, coding agents discover these five tools. Each entry identifies its function and whether it runs on the server or in the local client.
Home.withoutNpmClientToolWarning: The default npx configuration downloads and runs @anmezing/lce-cloud automatically. No global installation is required, and no functionality is lost. Only a direct Remote HTTP connection omits codebase_git_context and codebase_review_changes, plus local file watching, automatic incremental indexing, and branch-view tracking.
Home.npmClientModeDescription: Exposes five tools to the agent: the server-provided codebase-retrieval, codebase_symbol_graph, and codebase_enhance_prompt, plus the local codebase_git_context and codebase_review_changes. The client watches files, runs incremental indexing, and tracks the current branch view automatically.
Home.remoteHttpModeDescription: Exposes four server-provided tools: codebase-retrieval, codebase_symbol_graph, codebase_enhance_prompt, and codebase_index. The two local tools are unavailable, and the index must be maintained explicitly through codebase_index.

Home.afterSetupYourCodingAgentCanCall: After setup, your coding agent can call semantic search while working. You can also ask it to find a specific feature or symbol.
Home.retrievalEngineItDoesNotEditCode: retrieval engine. It does not edit code, run tests, or create pull requests.
Home.retrievalQualityDependsOnIndexCoverageFi: Retrieval quality depends on index coverage; files that are not indexed cannot appear in results.
Home.inCloudModeIndexingAndRetrievalBoth: In Cloud mode, indexing and retrieval both run in the cloud.
Home.gitStatusHistoryBlameAndChangeReview: Git status, history, blame, and change review run locally and are not sent to the cloud.
Home.typescriptJavascriptSymbolGraphsPreferBo: TypeScript/JavaScript symbol graphs prefer bounded compiler projects. Files outside the compilation budget fall back to AST or heuristic facts with coverage and confidence labels.
Home.theServerRejectsEnvFilesKeysBinaries: The server rejects .env files, keys, binaries, dependency directories, and build artifacts. Review repositories for other sensitive content before indexing.
